name: Surface Ceramic Spray

features.text: Extends the protection of waxes sealants

description: A specialized blend of lubricants, anti-static, and ceramic agents that clean and seal automotive painted surfaces, creating a mirror reflection and intense crystalline shine. SURFACE™ guards against harmful UV rays and environmental contaminants such brake dust, dirt, dust, industrial fallout, and bird droppings.
application: DIRECTIONS: to ensure an ideal bond, we recommend applying SURFACE ® to a clean, dry, and smooth surface. Spray SURFACE ® onto painted surfaces, one panel at a time. distribute evenly using a clean microfiber towel and buff to a smooth shiny surface. for vehicles already protected by ARMOUR ® ceramic coating use SURFACE ® to revitalize and extend shine and hydrophobic properties of ARMOUR ®

ad.headline: Durable & Hydrophobic
ad.description: A specialized blend of anti-static and ceramic agents designed to produce a water beading, brilliant, long-lasting shine. MP Surface® uses a combination of UV filters and stabilizers to guard against harmful UV rays and environmental contaminants such as brake dust, dirt, dust, and industrial fallout. Surface® bonds with vehicles clear coat to create a durable, hydrophobic surface, and it’s safe for all vehicle surfaces, including wheels and trim.
